title: 塞羅內格羅金礦
subcategoryTitleEn: Gold mines and deep underground systems
summary: 以巴塔哥尼亞金礦為例，分析多來源礦石、地下物流與水資源效率。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
summaryEn: A Patagonian gold case analyses multiple ore sources, underground logistics and water efficiency. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異；窄礦脈情境的樣品代表性；地下至地面交接的循環時間
v31FocusEn: Grade variation among different vein sources; Sample representativeness in a narrow-vein scenario; Cycle time across underground-to-surface handover

stages.title: 資源條件與系統邊界：塞羅內格羅金礦
stages.titleEn: Resource conditions and system boundaries: Cerro Negro gold mine
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」與「窄礦脈情境的樣品代表性」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Grade variation among different vein sources" and "Sample representativeness in a narrow-vein scenario": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Grade variation among different vein sources" is correct?
options: 兩種礦石的平均品位必須依乾質量加權，不能直接平均分析值。
兩批礦石的品位只要做算術平均即可。
重複分析同一瓶很多次就能消除取樣偏差。
optionsEn: Blend grade is weighted by dry mass, not by the number of assays.
The arithmetic mean of two ore grades is always the blend grade.
Repeatedly assaying one bottle eliminates sampling bias.
quiz.explanation: 兩種礦石的平均品位必須依乾質量加權，不能直接平均分析值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Blend grade is weighted by dry mass, not by the number of assays. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Grade variation among different vein sources: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」如何決定「塞羅內格羅金礦」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grade variation among different vein sources” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Cerro Negro gold mine”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 以「塞羅內格羅金礦」作案例背景，本單元的原創桌上問題是「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」。兩種礦石的平均品位必須依乾質量加權，不能直接平均分析值。配礦也會同時改變硬度、含泥量與有害元素；本模型只計算一個守恆的成分，需另以向量表保存其他性質及其限制。 這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Using Cerro Negro gold mine as the case setting, this original desk-based investigation addresses grade variation among different vein sources. Blend grade is weighted by dry mass, not by the number of assays. Blending also changes hardness, clay and penalty elements. This model balances one conserved component; retain the other properties and their constraints in a separate vector table. This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：以巴塔哥尼亞金礦為例，分析多來源礦石、地下物流與水資源效率。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。

quiz.question: 依「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」的模型 g = (m1·g1 + m2·g2)/(m1+m2)，配礦與品位變異的合成教學算例；輸入單位：m1: t dry; g1: mass %; m2: t dry; g2: mass %。不是該場址實測或操作值。最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model g = (m1·g1 + m2·g2)/(m1+m2) for "Grade variation among different vein sources", which value is closest to the synthetic teaching example for blending and grade variability; input units: m1: t dry; g1: mass %; m2: t dry; g2: mass %. These are not measured or operating values for this site.?
quiz.explanation: g = (m1·g1 + m2·g2)/(m1+m2)；代入 m1 = 5000 t dry、g1 = 1.1 mass %、m2 = 3000 t dry、g2 = 0.5 mass %，得 0.875 %（配礦與品位變異的合成教學算例；輸入單位：m1: t dry; g1: mass %; m2: t dry; g2: mass %。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: g = (m1·g1 + m2·g2)/(m1+m2); with m1 = 5000 t dry, g1 = 1.1 mass %, m2 = 3000 t dry, g2 = 0.5 mass % the result is 0.875 % (synthetic teaching example for blending and grade variability; input units: m1: t dry; g1: mass %; m2: t dry; g2: mass %. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Grade variation among different vein sources: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Grade variation among different vein sources” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：g = (m1·g1 + m2·g2)/(m1+m2)；代入 m1 = 5000 t dry、g1 = 1.1 mass %、m2 = 3000 t dry、g2 = 0.5 mass %，得 0.875 %（配礦與品位變異的合成教學算例；輸入單位：m1: t dry; g1: mass %; m2: t dry; g2: mass %。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 m2 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: g = (m1·g1 + m2·g2)/(m1+m2); with m1 = 5000 t dry, g1 = 1.1 mass %, m2 = 3000 t dry, g2 = 0.5 mass % the result is 0.875 % (synthetic teaching example for blending and grade variability; input units: m1: t dry; g1: mass %; m2: t dry; g2: mass %. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise m2 by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising m2 by 10% changes the result to 0.861 % (-1.5%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 0.875 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 m2 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 0.875 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in m2 with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Raising m2 by 10% changes the result to 0.861 % (-1.5%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Grade variation among different vein sources"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。
針對「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」，建立兩種端元與混合樣的合成表，核對取樣代表性及乾重；同時畫出平均值與批次波動，不能只驗收月平均。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.
For grade variation among different vein sources, build a synthetic table of two end members and mixed samples.
quiz.explanation: 針對「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」，建立兩種端元與混合樣的合成表，核對取樣代表性及乾重；同時畫出平均值與批次波動，不能只驗收月平均。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For grade variation among different vein sources, build a synthetic table of two end members and mixed samples; check sampling representativeness and dry weights, plotting both means and batch variation rather than accepting only a monthly average. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Grade variation among different vein sources: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grade variation among different vein sources” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」，建立兩種端元與混合樣的合成表，核對取樣代表性及乾重；同時畫出平均值與批次波動，不能只驗收月平均。 提交控制體圖與有單位的資料表，讓另一位學徒能獨立重算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For grade variation among different vein sources, build a synthetic table of two end members and mixed samples; check sampling representativeness and dry weights, plotting both means and batch variation rather than accepting only a monthly average. Submit a control-volume diagram and a table with units so another learner can recalculate independently. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保留各端元來源與重量，不以最後一次化驗覆蓋整個堆場的歷史。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain end-member provenance and weights instead of replacing stockpile history with the latest assay.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」情境，平均品位合格但處理不穩定，可能是粗細粒偏析或未納入的硬度差；分層取樣與粒度分析可以區分兩者。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In the scenario of grade variation among different vein sources, acceptable mean grade with unstable processing can arise from size segregation or omitted hardness contrasts; stratified sampling and size analysis discriminate between them. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Grade variation among different vein sources" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」情境，平均品位合格但處理不穩定，可能是粗細粒偏析或未納入的硬度差；分層取樣與粒度分析可以區分兩者。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
重複分析同一瓶很多次就能消除取樣偏差。
optionsEn: In the scenario of grade variation among different vein sources, acceptable mean grade with unstable processing can arise from size segregation or omitted hardness contrasts.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Repeatedly assaying one bottle eliminates sampling bias.
quiz.explanation: 在「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」情境，平均品位合格但處理不穩定，可能是粗細粒偏析或未納入的硬度差；分層取樣與粒度分析可以區分兩者。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: In the scenario of grade variation among different vein sources, acceptable mean grade with unstable processing can arise from size segregation or omitted hardness contrasts; stratified sampling and size analysis discriminate between them. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Grade variation among different vein sources: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Grade variation among different vein sources” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在「礦脈來源不同造成的品位變異」情境，平均品位合格但處理不穩定，可能是粗細粒偏析或未納入的硬度差；分層取樣與粒度分析可以區分兩者。 記錄哪一項獨立資料能排除替代原因。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「塞羅內格羅金礦」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: In the scenario of grade variation among different vein sources, acceptable mean grade with unstable processing can arise from size segregation or omitted hardness contrasts; stratified sampling and size analysis discriminate between them. Record which independent observation rules out an alternative cause. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “Cerro Negro gold mine”.
